title: module-service
description: The module service (Aufgabe 6): request rate, response time and error rate of its routes, the hop the user-mgmt backend opens to it (timeouts, retries, circuit breaker), its MySQL statements and pool, the runtime, the health checks, and the pods against their CPU and memory limits - the evidence for the vertical sizing.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Requests per second served by the module service (called by the backend only).

panels.title: Error rate (5xx)
panels.description: Share of the module service's responses with a 5xx status.

panels.title: Response time (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile of the module service's server-side request duration over 5 minutes.

panels.title: Instances up
panels.description: Module service pods answering the metrics scrape.

panels.title: Running version
panels.description: The image tag of the running pods (app.kubernetes.io/version, from the PodMonitor's podTargetLabels).

panels.title: Statement errors (5m)
panels.description: SQL statements the MySQL driver answered with an error in the last 5 minutes (a duplicate module code on create counts as one).

panels.title: Request rate by outcome
panels.description: Micrometer's outcome enumeration as the module service records it: SUCCESS, CLIENT_ERROR (404 unknown module, 409 duplicate code, 422 validation), SERVER_ERROR.

panels.title: Response time percentiles
panels.description: Quantiles computed from the http_server_requests histogram (shared buckets with every other component).

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Share of responses per status class over 5 minutes; the PrometheusRule alerts on the 5xx share.

panels.title: Request rate by endpoint
panels.description: Route templates (never raw paths): /api/v1/modules, /api/v1/modules/{module_id}, the OpenAPI routes; UNKNOWN is everything that matched no route.

panels.title: Response time (p95) by endpoint
panels.description: p95 per route template over 5 minutes.

panels.title: Requests in flight by endpoint
panels.description: Requests currently being served (http_server_requests_active). The synchronous endpoints run on a small worker pool, so a rising count under load means queueing on the event loop.

panels.title: Backend calls by route and outcome
panels.description: The backend's client-side view (http_client_requests_seconds, peer=modules): every call including retries, by the module service's route template.

panels.title: Client vs. server latency (p95)
panels.description: The same calls measured on both sides: the gap between the lines is the network between the pods plus the time retries add.

panels.title: Failed calls
panels.description: Share of backend calls ending in a 5xx (SERVER_ERROR) or a transport error / timeout (UNKNOWN). Retries on these are bounded; then the circuit breaker opens and the backend answers 503 on the module endpoints without calling.

targets.expr: 100 * sum (rate(http_client_requests_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", job="backend", peer="modules", outcome=~"SERVER_ERROR|UNKNOWN"}[5m])) / sum (rate(http_client_requests_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", job="backend", peer="modules"}[5m]))

100 * sum (rate(http_client_requests_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", job="backend", peer="modules", outcome="UNKNOWN"}[5m])) / sum (rate(http_client_requests_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", job="backend", peer="modules"}[5m]))

panels.title: Calls vs. requests served (retries)
panels.description: Client calls per second next to the requests the module service served: a client line above the server line is retried calls.

panels.title: Statement rate by operation
panels.description: SQL statements per second by operation (SQLAlchemy cursor events; the health checks are included as select).

panels.title: Statement latency (p95) by operation
panels.description: p95 of the statement duration per operation, same buckets as the request histograms - compare with the response time above.

panels.title: Statement errors by operation (5m)
panels.description: Statements the driver answered with an error; an insert error is a duplicate code, anything else points at the managed MySQL or the schema.

panels.title: Connection pool
panels.description: SQLAlchemy pool state at scrape time, summed over the pods: checked_out is in use, overflow are connections above the pool size opened under load (up to DB_POOL_MAX_OVERFLOW).

panels.title: Process CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used by the process (process_cpu_seconds_total); one event loop, so about 1 core is the ceiling.

panels.title: Process memory (RSS)
panels.description: Resident memory of the native executable per pod.

panels.title: Threads and file descriptors
panels.description: Live threads (event loop, worker pool, health checker) and open file descriptors per pod.

panels.title: Health checks (1 = ok)
panels.description: health_check_up per check from the admin port: database (SELECT 1 on the managed MySQL) and schema (the modules table exists, i.e. the seed Job ran). A failing check makes /readyz answer 503 and takes the pod out of rotation.

panels.title: Health check duration
panels.description: Time each check took in its last cycle (max over the pods); the checker timeout is 2 s.

panels.title: CPU usage vs. limit
panels.description: Share of the CPU limit each pod uses. Sustained values near 100 % throttle the event loop and show up as latency - the cue to raise components.modules.resources.limits.cpu.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", container="modules"}[5m])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace", container="modules", resource="cpu"})

panels.title: CPU throttling
panels.description: Share of CFS periods in which the container was throttled at its limit.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", container="modules"}[5m])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", container="modules"}[5m]))

panels.title: Memory usage vs. limit
panels.description: Working set as a share of the memory limit; 100 % is an OOM kill and a restart.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", container="modules"}) / sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace", container="modules", resource="memory"})

panels.title: modules pods - CPU
panels.description: CPU cores per pod against the request and the limit.

panels.title: modules pods - memory
panels.description: Working set per pod against the request and the limit.

panels.title: modules replicas and restarts
panels.description: Ready replicas of the modules Deployment (a fixed count per environment - the service scales vertically) and container restarts in the last hour.
